messages.subject: adding legend in ggplot2
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am creating this county map and overlaying it with hospitals and clinics by lat and long. I wanted the points for hospitals to be unique and the same point for all clinics. Below is what I did:

hosp <- zm2_base3 + geom_point(data=hospitals, aes(x=lon, y=lat), colour = "black", size = 4.5, show.legend = F) +
               geom_point(data=hospitals,  aes(x=lon, y=lat),colour = "pink", size = 4, show.legend = F) +
       geom_point(data=hospitals,  aes(x=lon, y=lat, shape = factor(hospitals$hospital)), show.legend = F) +
       geom_text(data=hospitals, aes(x=lon, y=lat, label=as.character(hospitals$hospital)), color="black",  fontface="bold", hjust = 0.5, vjust=-1, size=2.5, nudge_x=0.01)
     hosp<- hosp  + scale_shape(guide=FALSE)
 hosp 

clinic <- hosp  + geom_point(data=clinics, aes(x=lon, y=lat, group=group), shape=24, colour="#FF3399", size = 1.5, show.legend = F) 
clinic 

I turned out very pretty but the problem is I can not add the legend (a triangle shape with a label saying clinic).  I was about to give up and would use photo shop or some sort to add it in manually.  But really want to figure it out. Please see the attachment.

Thanks!!!
